subtitle: Every great company has defining moments. These are ours - the milestones that shaped who we are today.

milestones.title: Company Founded
milestones.description: WhiteGuard was founded with a clear mission to simplify cybersecurity and make it accessible, scalable, and effective for every organization. From day one, the focus was on building real impact through innovation and execution.

milestones.title: Pre-Seed Funding Secured
milestones.description: A major milestone that validated the vision — securing pre-seed investment to accelerate growth, expand capabilities, and strengthen our position in the cybersecurity market across the region.

milestones.title: Launching White Hawk
milestones.description: Introducing White Hawk — our AI-powered cybersecurity platform that unifies security operations, GRC, and asset management into one intelligent system, redefining how organizations manage and act on cyber risks.
